description: Bundled response playbooks. The Playbook viewer on the Attack Analysis page queries /api/v1/playbooks?stage=...&technique=... and renders matched + fallback. Each playbook has steps; steps with kind != 'manual' carry a payload that the UI POSTs to /api/v1/actions endpoints.

playbooks.title: Contain shell-execution chain
playbooks.description: Attacker is running shell commands on a host. Halt the shell, capture audit context, escalate.

steps.title: Capture process tree on host
steps.rationale: Snapshot ps + open files before containment so the post-incident report has the executing tree.

steps.title: Approve next DQN action
steps.rationale: Let the policy escalate when CKC ≥ 4 — review the q-values, then Approve in the Action Log.

steps.title: Isolate host (network)
steps.rationale: Cut north-south flow while you investigate. Audit-only — un-isolate via Wazuh console after.

steps.title: Open host page → Audit tab
steps.rationale: Walk the auditd events around the trigger time; correlate with Defense Evasion if the operator cleared logs.

playbooks.title: Discovery-tactic Q&A
playbooks.description: Attacker is enumerating users/processes/network — Discovery doesn't itself harm but signals stage progression.

steps.title: Confirm chain not legitimate sysadmin
steps.rationale: Discovery commands look identical to admin work; check the chain's origin host and time-of-day pattern.

steps.title: Block source IP if external
steps.rationale: If the chain originated outside the trusted segment, block at the perimeter.

steps.title: Watch for lateral move
steps.rationale: Pivot to Topology — if neighboring hosts open new chains within 30 min, escalate.

playbooks.title: Privilege escalation containment
playbooks.description: Sudo abuse, kernel exploit, or other PrivEsc technique. High urgency.

steps.title: Isolate host immediately
steps.rationale: PrivEsc → root. Cut network before lateral move.

steps.title: Approve all pending DQN actions on this chain
steps.rationale: Don't second-guess the policy at CKC 4+; review afterwards.

playbooks.title: Persistence — clean account artefacts
playbooks.description: Attacker created or modified accounts to survive reboot.

steps.title: Enumerate user/group changes since opened_at
steps.rationale: Get the diff between baseline /etc/passwd and current state.

steps.title: Block user IP for chain originator
steps.rationale: Stop fresh logins under the new identity while you remediate.

steps.title: Disable created accounts in IDP / local
steps.rationale: Audit-only here — actually disable in Wazuh / system console.

playbooks.title: Command-and-control — block egress
playbooks.description: Outbound C2 traffic detected. Block the destination, capture traffic.

playbooks.title: Generic incident triage
playbooks.description: No technique-specific playbook applies — work the chain top-down.

steps.title: Open the host page
steps.rationale: See the full alert stream around opened_at on this chain.

steps.title: Mark case status
steps.rationale: Move the chain to investigating in the Cases queue once you start work.
